title: Sample review round
intro: A made-up review round, so you can judge how the control room's Review tab looks and reads. scripts/control_room.py review reads only the items below.

items.heading: What were these 6 sessions for?
items.lede: These are six made-up work sessions on a small recipe app called Pantry Notes. For each one, read how it started and give it a short name for what the session was for. Keep the same word for the same kind of work, so similar sessions end up together.
items.placeholder: one word or a hyphenated phrase
items.assist: Propose one goal label for this work session: lowercase, 1 to 3 words joined by hyphens, naming what the person was trying to get done. Prefer a label already in use when it fits.

rows.title: Search box returns nothing for words with capitals
rows.meta: Pantry Notes, Monday morning, about 25 minutes

turns.text: When I type "Tomato" in the search box I get no recipes, but "tomato" works. Can you find out why?
The search compares the words exactly as typed, so capital letters do not match. I can make it ignore case and add a test for it.
Yes, do that. Also check that accents like in "jalapeño" still work.

rows.title: Add a cooking time field to each recipe
rows.meta: Pantry Notes, Monday afternoon, about 50 minutes

turns.text: I want every recipe to show how long it takes to cook. Can we add a field for that?
Yes. I will add a cooking time in minutes to the recipe form and the recipe page, and leave it empty for old recipes.
Looks good. Show it as "1 h 20 min" instead of "80" on the page.

rows.title: Tests fail after updating the date library
rows.meta: Pantry Notes, Tuesday morning, about 35 minutes

turns.text: I updated the date library and now four tests fail. Can you get them passing again?
The new version prints dates in a slightly different format. The app is fine; the tests expect the old format. I can update the tests.
Fine, but make sure the shopping list still sorts by date correctly.

rows.title: Write the getting-started notes for new helpers

turns.text: A friend wants to help with the app. Can you write short notes on how to set it up and run it?
I will write a short page: what to install, how to start the app, how to run the tests, and where the main parts live.
Keep it to one screen. She is new to this, so explain any word she might not know.

rows.title: Shopping list adds the same item twice
rows.meta: Pantry Notes, Thursday evening, about 30 minutes

turns.text: If two recipes both need onions, the shopping list shows onions twice. Can it add them up instead?
Right now each recipe adds its own line. I can merge lines with the same item and unit, and keep them apart when the units differ.
Good. "2 onions" and "1 onion" should become "3 onions", not "3 onion".

rows.title: Make the recipe page readable on a phone

turns.text: On my phone the recipe page is cut off on the right side. Can you fix the layout?
The ingredient table is too wide for small screens. I can stack it into a simple list when the screen is narrow.
Better. Make the step numbers bigger too, I read them while cooking.
